name: Team Interview Rubric

descriptions.expert: Team shows evidence of independent inquiry from the beginning stages of their design process. This includes brainstorming, testing, and exploring alternative solutions.
descriptions.proficient: Team shows evidence of independent inquiry for some elements of their design process.
descriptions.emerging: Team shows little to no evidence of independent inquiry in their design process.

descriptions.expert: Team can fully explain their entire game strategy including game analysis.
descriptions.proficient: Team can explain their current strategy with limited evidence of game analysis.
descriptions.emerging: Team did not explain game strategy, or strategy is not student-directed.

descriptions.expert: Team can fully explain the evolution of their robot design to the current design.
descriptions.proficient: Team can provide a limited description of why the current robot design was chosen, but shows limited evolution.
descriptions.emerging: Team did not explain robot design, or design is not student-directed.

descriptions.expert: Team can fully explain their robot construction. Ownership of the robot build is evident.
descriptions.proficient: Team can describe why the current robot design was chosen, but with limited explanation.
descriptions.emerging: Team did not explain robot build, or build is not student-directed.

descriptions.expert: Team can fully explain the evolution of their programming.
descriptions.proficient: Team can describe how the current programs work, but with limited evolution.
descriptions.emerging: Team did not explain programming, or programming is not student-directed.

descriptions.expert: Team can describe creative aspect(s) of their robot with clarity and detail.
descriptions.proficient: Team can describe a creative solution but the answer lacks detail.
descriptions.emerging: Team has difficulty describing a creative solution or gives minimal response.

descriptions.expert: Team can explain how team progress was tracked against an overall project timeline. Team can explain management of material and personnel resources.
descriptions.proficient: Team can explain how team progress was monitored, and some degree of management of material and personnel resources.
descriptions.emerging: Team cannot explain how team progress was monitored or how resources were managed.

descriptions.expert: Most or all team members contribute to explanations of the design process, game strategy, and other work done by the team.
descriptions.proficient: Some team members contribute to explanations of the design process, game strategy, and other work done by the team.
descriptions.emerging: Few team members contribute to explanations of the design process, game strategy, and other work done by the team.

descriptions.expert: Team consistently interacts respectfully, courteously, and positively in their interview.
descriptions.proficient: Team interactions show signs of respect and courtesy, but there is room for improvement.
descriptions.emerging: Team interactions lack respectful and courteous behavior.

specialAttributesSection.name: Special Attributes & Overall Impressions
specialAttributesSection.prompt: Does the team have any special attributes, accomplishments, or exemplary effort in overcoming challenges at this event? Did anything stand out about this team in their interview? Please describe:

notes: All judging materials are strictly confidential. They are not shared beyond the Judges and Judge Advisor and shall be destroyed at the end of the event.
